_about: Public-domain E. W. Bullinger (Ethelbert William Bullinger, 1837-1913), Anglican clergyman and dispensationalist Bible scholar, for the Word Hoard: A Critical Lexicon and Concordance to the English and Greek New Testament (fourth edition, 1895), The Witness of the Stars (1893), Number in Scripture (1894), Figures of Speech Used in the Bible (1898), The Book of Job (1903), The Church Epistles (1905) and How to Enjoy the Bible (1907), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Not Heinrich Bullinger, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
